newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures down in quiet pre-auction trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures down in quiet pre-auction trade.

text.p: Aug 5 - U.S. debt futures were lower heading into midday, defensive before first leg of quarterly refunding. Treasury to sell $16.0 bln 3-yrs, bidding deadline is 1200 CDT/1700 GMT. One floor source said good auction will boost Sept T-bond above 114-22/32, sloppy results will press T-bond to 114-4/32 support.
